description: This file is an HTML source that implements the user interface for a Database Viewer web application, including layout, styling, and client-side scripting to interact with a backend API to list databases, tables, and display table data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing database entries to show their tables, and loads tables when expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table, limits to 50 records, and displays it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs the HTML table for displaying data rows, with special handling for wide or object data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cells, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandable view.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long text or objects, toggling between truncated and full view.
